overall_summary: Analysis of historical performance reveals that deep marital and relationship reality themes (husband-wife dynamics) significantly outperform general family shayari or abstract sadness, garnering over 1,700 views compared to the usual 100-300 view baseline.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' (1,767 views) and 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए' (1,674 views) generated 5x to 10x more views than other content.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on mature relationship dynamics, post-marriage compromises, and everyday unspoken partner tensions.

winning_patterns.pattern: Direct Relatable Hooks on Everyday Stress
winning_patterns.evidence: Titles addressing a specific common dilemma ('Har Baar Sorry Bolne Wala Galat Nahi Hota', 'Ek Mard Bhi Kabhi Ladka Tha') perform steadily in the 300-400 view range.
winning_patterns.action: Use conversational second-person hooks that address relationship nuances and emotional compromises.

weak_patterns.pattern: Abstract or Overly Poetic Sad Shayari
weak_patterns.evidence: Titles like 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा… रिश्तों को षड्यंत्र लिखूंगा' received only 19 views, showing that overly dramatic poetry lacks mass connection compared to grounded real-life observation.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid heavy, obscure poetic words; ground the shayari or emotional narrative in concrete household or relational situations.

weak_patterns.evidence: Early sister-focused videos ('बहन सिर्फ घर की रौनक होती है') stalled at 19 views when the framing lacked a compelling emotional conflict.
weak_patterns.action: Always anchor family dynamics around a specific moment of realization or unspoken sacrifice rather than generalized praise.
